summary: Adia Med filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing that on September 30, 2026 it, with subsidiary Adia Labs LLC, entered a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to sell 30 of 100 Labs units—a 30% stake—to Live Oak Health LLC (QCM Biologics) at $50,000 per unit, or $1.5 million total. Consideration comprises $1.0 million cash plus a $500,000 7% promissory note, secured by a first-priority pledge of the purchased units, due 48 months out. Buyer also holds an option for 10 more units at $50,000 each through September 30, 2028. Watch closing confirmations, payment collection, and pledge enforcement risk.
